concept: SCP: deny disabling CloudTrail in all Organizations accounts
tests: Which mechanism denies actions in member accounts regardless of their own IAM permissions.
expected: SCP on the OU with Deny cloudtrail:StopLogging and cloudtrail:DeleteTrail — caps maximum permissions, overrides local IAM permissions. Triggers: "AWS Organizations", "regardless of the account's own IAM permissions", "prevent any member account".
why_not: Permission boundaries are per principal, easy to miss; an IAM role with a deny doesn't cover everyone; a CloudWatch alarm only reacts after the fact, doesn't prevent.
